name: Pornassio (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pornassio (a tower beneath a bend on white and blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Pornassio, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pornassio arms — tower beneath a bend on white and blue, crowned, within branches
